reason: TENSO uses tree-tensor-network HEOM propagation to control quantum-dynamics simulation cost and demonstrates chemistry/physics examples. Its resource section notes stiff equations can require tiny steps and runtime depends on the system. The full paper is an open-quantum-systems software package, with no language-model or serving connection.
title: TENSO: Software Package for Numerically Exact Open Quantum Dynamics Based on Efficient Tree Tensor Network Decomposition of the Hierarchical Equations of Motion
